name: Squallgig
description: Thrust with the lead hand and lead foot landing as one and the rear pair following a beat behind.

name: Squall Triprong
description: Slip a thrust along the haft by bending at the waist like a reed in a current.

name: Squalltrident
description: Cross uneven ground placing each foot like a river stone so that the stance stays level.

name: Vigor Forktine
description: Rake across the guard with the left outer tine and return the right to cover the line.

name: Gathering Socketbase
description: Gather an opponent's weapon into the basin of the fork and hold it there with steady paired pressure.

name: Reminiscence Barbtine
description: Probe the guard with a light thrust and read the answering weight as a hawk reads the field below.

name: Gaff Decree
description: Send two currents of qi down the haft in step so that they land as one through the center prong.

name: Brimming Midtine
description: Hold the fork before the body as a barrier that qi fills the way water fills a basin.

name: Peal Gig
description: Turn the fork over a weapon and the arm behind it in one motion that throws the opponent off balance.

name: Harmonious Tenet Tridentshaft
description: Run the school's first sequence of paired thrust and paired rake and basin bar in one unbroken flow taught to every pupil.

name: Paramount Triplehead
description: Jab along the left track with the center prong while the right track holds guard.

name: Bedrock Prongroot
description: Hold the right track with the haft low so that a counterthrust meets wood.

name: Hookbarb Odyssey
description: Slide between the tracks by a short sidestep that keeps the tines levelled.

name: Steel Pinch
description: Strike at two heights at once with an outer tine on each track.

name: Pall Triprong
description: Cross the tracks at the instant of contact so that a blade is carried from one to the other.

name: Pinchpledge
description: Hook the barb under the opponent's lead arm from the lower track and draw it across.

name: Triovoyage
description: Chain steps along both tracks so that the tines stay on the opponent whichever way the body turns.

name: Magnificent Seize
description: Follow a retreating opponent along both tracks with a qi-driven thrust that arrives down the open one.

name: Tripletroth
description: Place a snare of qi on the second track so that a foe who steps aside is caught in it.

name: Vacuum Gig
description: Drive qi down both tracks into a single lance that punches through guard and armor alike.

name: Symphonic Fork
description: Run the school's doctrine form in which one track draws the guard and the other delivers the thrust.

name: Quenched Sidetine
description: Thrust along a line as straight as a river reach with the center prong leading.

name: Statute Tridentshaft
description: Spread the arms wide with the haft level like a hawk's wings to cover chest and flanks.

name: Forkgrace
description: Hop from one foot to the other along an imagined bank to keep a moving opponent in line.

name: Squalltrio
description: Draw a cut into the opening of the fork and let it run away down the haft.

name: Prismgig
description: Pitch the weight forward and down in a diving thrust that qi drives deep through the guard.

name: Famed Midtine
description: Sweep the haft low and long across both ankles like a river running over stones.

name: Authoritative Prongroot
description: Hold a caught blade in the fork midway between both hands and let qi pressure keep it there.

name: Sidetine Benison
description: Step to a higher footing and read the opponent's guard from above before choosing the thrust.

name: Gloom Fork
description: Press the tines down on a guard with the slow heavy force of a river in flood.

name: Dunetriple
description: Hold a hovering trap of qi overhead like a perched hawk and drop it on the first reach.

name: Thunderclap Barbtine
description: Strike from the hawk's height and the river's low line at one instant so that no guard covers both.

name: Tenettrident
description: Run the school's form of high dive and low sweep and held fork so that the two lines of attack work as one.

name: Paramount Gaff
description: Open with a jab from the lead hand and let the rear hand answer it with a second at once.

name: Steel Socketbase
description: Stand with the fork forward and both hands braced as one pair across the chest.

name: Ethereal Seize
description: Step diagonally to a corner of the fighting space so that the opponent must turn to follow.

name: Trioverdict
description: Feint with the left hand's tines and strike with the right hand's as if two forks held the line.

name: Delugetrio
description: Let a thrust pass between the guard hands and turn it aside with the following tine.

name: Sigil Prongdrive
description: Pin an opponent's weapon to the ground at the center of the stance and hold it with qi.

name: Gafftriumph
description: Deliver one qi-sharpened thrust after both hands have weighed the opening and agreed on the line.

name: Sigilfork
description: Draw the tines round the edge of the fighting space and seal it against the opponent's weapon with qi.

name: Wraithlike Pinch
description: Cross the whole width of the court in a flash and strike from the side the opponent left open.

name: Harmonious Prongdrive Triumph
description: Run the school's form in which the two hands play the roles of two forks and exchange them each beat.

name: Hookbarb Edict
description: Jab without a pause between withdrawal and the next advance so that the motion runs on.

name: Shifting Forktine
description: Hold the haft so that its angle changes constantly and no blow finds a still surface.

name: Bedrock Fork
description: Match each step to the pace of the opponent's advance so that the distance never changes.

name: Vacuumfork
description: Link two thrusts by one flow of qi so that the second follows the first through the same wound.

name: Thunderclap Sidetine
description: Let the fork flow around a weapon shaft and wrench it from the hand with a turn of the wrist.

name: Unbending Prongroot
description: Hook the barb below the opponent's guard and drag the leg back like an undertow.

name: Eclipse Midtine
description: Touch the opponent's weapon with a tine and read from its pull which way the force will run.

name: Prismtrident
description: Spin the tines before the body in a continuous screen of qi that stops missiles and cuts.

name: Statute Triprong
description: Spread a flood of qi across the ground in the form of a pattern that holds every foot upon it.

name: Seize Edict
description: Loose a torrent of qi from the center prong in a narrow lance that crosses the field.

name: Volition Barbtine
description: Run the school's long form in which each guard flows into a thrust and each thrust into a guard.

name: Peerless Triplehead
description: Seat the weight low and thrust from the belly so that the whole body drives the center prong.

name: Bedrock Socketbase
description: Sink into the low stance of the basin floor with the fork held wide against any approach.

name: Gliding Gaff
description: Glide along one track and switch to the other without lifting the heels from the ground.

name: Triplehead Troth
description: Turn from the center of the body so that the haft carries a heavy cut away without strain.

name: Steel Gig
description: Draw qi from the formed Core into the center prong and drive through light mail.

name: Triplevow
description: Pulse qi from the Core into both hands in turn to hold a guard that does not tire.

name: Millstone Forktine
description: Pin a limb under the fork and anchor the hold in the body's center so that it cannot be pulled free.

name: Vigortriple
description: Slip along the rim of the opponent's reach and re-enter on the weak side with the tines low.

name: Steeltriple
description: Send a lance of Core qi down the center prong to pierce a guard held by shield and haft together.

name: Ruling Hookbarb
description: Hold the fork over a weapon arm and seal it with qi drawn from the Core like water held in a basin.

name: Prismtrio
description: Meet a heavy qi blow on the fork and turn its force back on the attacker through the center prong.

name: Harmonious Triplehead Triumph
description: Run the school's highest trident form in which Core qi passes through each hand and each tine in order.

name: Steel Prongdrive
description: Jab from a rooted stance as an oath is spoken once and kept to the end.

name: Devout Tridentshaft
description: Hold the haft across the line of the wind so that the blown force presses it into place.

name: Squall Socketbase
description: Slide across open ground in the lee of the wind keeping the tines low and level.

name: Thunderclap Prongroot
description: Extend to the full reach and hold the thrust a moment as an oath is held.

name: Pall Sidetine
description: Shift the haft with a change in the wind so that the parry meets the blade from the side.

name: Sigil Pinch
description: Take a bearing on the weapon hand and pin it to its line with the outer tine.

name: Vigor Seize
description: Spring from the rock of the plateau into a long step that carries the tines past the guard.

name: Splendid Pinch
description: Thrust at the crest of a gust so that its force and the wielder's qi arrive together.

name: Trioseal
description: Lay a sworn line of qi on the ground and let it seize the foot of whoever crosses.

name: Prism Hookbarb
description: Send a lance of qi down a sworn line on a rising wind and pierce a guard of plate.

name: Tenetfork
description: Run the school's first form in which oath and guard and thrust follow the wind across open ground.

name: Royal Gig
description: Set the tines on a bearing and thrust once along it without drifting.

name: Undaunted Forktine
description: Stand in the sworn stance with feet planted and the fork held up before the chest.

name: Windborne Gaff
description: Walk forward along a held bearing keeping the tines pointed at the same spot on the foe.

name: Squall Tridentshaft
description: Cross the opponent's bearing with the haft and send the weapon off along the new line.

name: Vigor Prongdrive
description: Repeat the same jab along the same line three times with qi rising on each.

name: Sigil Triprong
description: Hook the barb round the weapon arm on a gust and pull it off its line.

name: Steel Midtine
description: Enter across the opponent's bearing with a qi-driven shoulder and strike before the guard re-forms.

name: Tridentshaft Troth
description: Draw a line of qi across the ground with the tines and seal the opponent from crossing it.

name: Thunderclap Fork
description: Drive a thrust along the sworn bearing with enough qi that no guard on that line can hold.

name: Harmonious Forktine Banner
description: Run the school's form of taking a bearing and swearing to it and then driving along it.

name: Sidetine Triumph
description: Thrust in open air with no wall at the back and the whole body committed to the point.

name: Tridentpledge
description: Hold the guard high with no cover at the back and turn to meet any side.

name: Twilit Barbtine
description: Lean into a gale and advance one hard step at a time without losing the line of the tines.

name: Unwavering Triprong
description: Cut the haft through the wind to meet a blade early and throw it wide.

name: Thunderclap Socketbase
description: Drive the fork forward on a gust of qi that tears through leather and mail alike.

name: Peal Hookbarb
description: Whirl the haft before the body in the open and let qi make the circle a moving guard.

name: Commanding Barbtine
description: Hook the barb into the opponent's guard ring and tear it open from the side.

name: Standing Triplehead
description: Plant the haft and stand against a charge as a standing wind stands against a banner.

name: Wily Midtine
description: Let a drift of qi settle across open ground and snare the foot that steps through it.

name: Undaunted Prongroot
description: Spin the fork to throw a broad ward of qi round the stance in place of any wall.

name: Triumphant Fork
description: Sweep the fork round to loose a gale of qi across open ground that strikes all within it.

name: Triotriumph
description: Run the school's form in which thrust and ward and sweep are made in the open with no wall behind.

name: Steeltrio
description: Jab along the edge of the opponent's reach as sworn to the wind and the line.

name: Steeltrident
description: Stand at the plateau's edge with the fork forward and the drop behind the foe.

name: Evanescent Gig
description: Pace along the windward side of the opponent to keep the gusts at the wielder's back.

name: Intrepid Pinch
description: Rake with the outer tine on the rising edge of a gust so that qi doubles the cut.

name: Squall Midtine
description: Sweep a blade off the guard along the edge of the haft and out beyond the stance.

name: Imperious Triplehead
description: Hook the barb on the opponent's belt and haul the body toward the edge of the stance.

name: Vigortrident
description: Snap the fork out past full reach on a burst of qi and recover to guard at once.

name: Shrewd Socketbase
description: Stretch a trap line of qi along the edge so that any foot set on it is held.

name: Radiance Sidetine
description: Drive the fork along the sworn edge with qi so heavy that it forces a way through any guard.

name: Grand Season Fork
description: Run the school's form in which each stroke is made along the edge and answered by the wind.

name: Gaffbanner
description: Open the long oath with a single jab that promises everything after it.

name: Bedrock Hookbarb
description: Hold the fork as sworn with its three tines level and unmoving before the chest.

name: Seizeodyssey
description: Take a long stride that covers the oath's full length in one movement of the legs.

name: Squall Forktine
description: Turn a blade aside on a thin field of qi that extends just beyond the haft.

name: Radiance Gig
description: Chain three thrusts along a single line as three links of one pledge.

name: Sigil Prongroot
description: Hook the barb on a weapon guard and pull it round to the wielder's bearing.

name: Gracious Barbtine
description: Step into the open wind and read through the qi field where the opponent's weight will shift.

name: Steel Gaff
description: Drive the fork forward inside a field of qi that carries the thrust past the guard.

name: Sigiltrio
description: Pin the three tines to three points on a limb and seal the limb with a held oath of qi.

name: Sigil Tridentshaft
description: Meet a charged blow on the fork and nullify it by holding one exact bearing against it.

name: Symphonic Volition Pinch
description: Run the school's long form in which one oath is carried unbroken through every stroke.

name: Haemal Forktine
description: Thrust from a stance rooted in the body's center along the edge of the opponent's reach.

name: Deflecting Barbtine
description: Stand open to the gale with the fork forward and let the wind pass over the guard.

name: Duneseize
description: Stride across the ground with the gale at the back and the tines aimed ahead.

name: Famed Prongdrive
description: Draw wind and Core qi together through the center prong and drive it into a guard.

name: Faithful Triprong
description: Hold one bearing with the haft while Core qi keeps the guard steady against many blows.

name: Unbending Prongdrive
description: Pin a limb under the fork with a force that stands as firm as plateau rock.

name: Lifegiving Prongroot
description: Touch the opponent's guard with a tine and read the wind's answer through the Core field.

name: Prism Pinch
description: Loose a lance of Core qi on a gale down the center prong to pierce a strong guard.

name: Tridentseal
description: Draw a binding line of Core qi along the wind and seal a weapon arm across it.

name: Prismtriple
description: Meet a heavy blow with the fork along one bearing and send its force back on the attacker.

name: Season Gig
description: Run the school's highest form in which Core qi and gale and bearing move as one through the fork.
